title.zh-CN: 交互式 HTML 演练页

summary.zh-CN: 生成自包含的单文件 HTML 演练页：一侧是控件，一侧实时预览，底部输出可复制的提示词。附视觉设计、数据查询、概念图、文档批注、代码差异评审、代码架构六类模板。
summary.en: Creates a self-contained single-file HTML playground: controls on one side, a live preview on the other, and a copyable prompt at the bottom. Includes six templates: visual design, data queries, concept maps, document critique, diff review and code architecture.

conditions.zh-CN: 正文第 4 步的 open 命令仅适用于 macOS；在 Teloa 中请按输出的文件路径预览
conditions.en: The open command in step 4 only works on macOS; in Teloa, preview the file at the path reported

conditions.zh-CN: 正文说把生成的提示词复制回 Claude；在 Teloa 中复制回当前对话即可
conditions.en: The skill says to copy the generated prompt back into Claude; in Teloa, paste it back into the current conversation

conditions.zh-CN: 文档批注与代码差异评审模板未要求转义嵌入内容；处理第三方文档或 diff 时，请让助手把内容以 JSON 嵌入并用 textContent 渲染
conditions.en: The document-critique and diff-review templates do not require escaping embedded content; for third-party documents or diffs, ask the assistant to embed the content as JSON and render it with textContent

conditions.zh-CN: 许可为上游仓库根目录的 LICENSE（Apache-2.0），不在技能目录内
conditions.en: The license is the LICENSE (Apache-2.0) at the upstream repository root, outside the skill directory
